posts.title: Launching Nonprofit Resources
posts.summary: Why we are building a catalog outside the sales funnel.
posts.html:
Nonprofit operators should not have to dig through GitHub raw lists or TechSoup consulting funnels to find free and discounted digital tools.

Nonprofit Resources is a consumer-grade catalog of first-party vendor portals, community meta-directories, DIY options, and free software — with verification notes and AlternativeTo links where helpful.

Subscribe to this news feed for catalog updates and offer-change alerts.
